value.rationale: The claim identifies the smallest convex-position counterexample to the intuition that microscopic mass at exposed vertices must be nonnegative and provides a continuous, geometrically intrinsic sign partition for every triangle. It is a natural exact invariant of finite Euclidean distance-energy optimization, not merely a renamed matrix inverse or unmotivated special number. The weighted-focus oval is classical in isolation; its exact signed-weight role and sharp minimum are the substantive result.
